description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged jump attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Wind], [Awoken Wind], [Damage Cap +10000], [Flight of Intrigue Mode] and [Dream of Space] to the user

description.name: Attach Wind
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Wind damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Wind resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken Wind
description.text: Wind abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Wind abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Flight of Intrigue Mode
description.text: Casts Rocket Dive after using four Wind abilities

description.name: Dream of Space
description.text: Grants [Dragoon +30% Boost 1] to all allies in the character's row after using a Dragoon ability
